Industrial Control.reason: Siemens IoT2050 executes unchecked configuration file commands, allowing attackers who manipulate configs to run arbitrary code on industrial edge devices.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Siemens IoT2050 executes unchecked configuration file commands, allowing attackers who manipulate configs to run arbitrary code on industrial edge devices.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Siemens IoT2050 执行未经校验的配置文件命令，允许操纵配置的攻击者在工业边缘设备上执行任意代码。

Industrial Control.reason: Siemens Mendix Studio Pro exposes its HTTP listener to external networks, risking unauthorized access to critical low-code development environments used in IIoT.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Siemens Mendix Studio Pro exposes its HTTP listener to external networks, risking unauthorized access to critical low-code development environments used in IIoT.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Siemens Mendix Studio Pro 将其 HTTP 监听器暴露至外部网络，导致用于 IIoT 的关键低代码开发环境面临未授权访问风险。

Industrial Control.reason: Incorrect probe function sequencing in the MPU3050 gyro driver exposes race conditions that can destabilize critical monitoring systems in ICS environments.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Incorrect probe function sequencing in the MPU3050 gyro driver exposes race conditions that can destabilize critical monitoring systems in ICS environments.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: MPU3050 陀螺仪驱动程序中探测函数调用顺序错误暴露了竞态条件，可能导致 ICS 环境中的关键监控系统失稳。

Industrial Control.reason: Unsynchronized NAND lock/unlock operations risk data corruption in flash storage controllers commonly deployed in industrial PLCs and SCADA systems.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Unsynchronized NAND lock/unlock operations risk data corruption in flash storage controllers commonly deployed in industrial PLCs and SCADA systems.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: NAND 锁/解锁操作不同步会导致闪存存储控制器中的数据损坏风险，此类控制器常见于工业 PLC 和 SCADA 系统中。

Industrial Control.reason: Improper escaping in Siemens ROS# message definitions allows attackers to inject and execute arbitrary code in control programs.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Improper escaping in Siemens ROS# message definitions allows attackers to inject and execute arbitrary code in control programs.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Siemens ROS# 消息定义中的转义处理不当允许攻击者在控制程序中注入并执行任意代码。

Industrial Control.reason: Implicit active content execution in Siemens WinCC tricks operators into running malicious code on SCADA workstations.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Implicit active content execution in Siemens WinCC tricks operators into running malicious code on SCADA workstations.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Siemens WinCC 中的隐式活动对象执行会诱骗操作员在 SCADA 工作站上运行恶意代码。

Industrial Control.reason: Cleartext storage of sensitive information in Johnson Controls EasyIO memory allows retrieval of embedded control system credentials.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Cleartext storage of sensitive information in Johnson Controls EasyIO memory allows retrieval of embedded control system credentials.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Johnson Controls EasyIO 内存中以明文形式存储敏感信息，使得攻击者可提取嵌入式控制系统凭据。

Web Security.reason: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, weakening web application security frameworks.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, weakening web application security frameworks.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的身份验证缺陷允许通过网络进行未授权的权限提升，削弱了 Web 应用安全框架。

Web Security.reason: Authorization flaw in SharePoint enables privilege escalation across web collaboration platforms, potentially exposing sensitive organizational data.
Web Security.reason_en: Authorization flaw in SharePoint enables privilege escalation across web collaboration platforms, potentially exposing sensitive organizational data.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的授权缺陷允许跨 Web 协作平台进行权限提升，可能导致敏感的组织数据泄露。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Teams facilitates user spoofing and credential harvesting through manipulated web page generation.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Teams facilitates user spoofing and credential harvesting through manipulated web page generation.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可通过操纵网页生成实现用户伪造和凭据窃取。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in Visual Studio Code enables attackers to bypass security boundaries and probe internal networks over the network.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Visual Studio Code enables attackers to bypass security boundaries and probe internal networks over the network.
Web Security.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞使攻击者能够绕过安全边界并通过网络探测内部网络。

Web Security.reason: Command injection in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized local code execution, threatening developer environments and third-party extension integrity.
Web Security.reason_en: Command injection in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized local code execution, threatening developer environments and third-party extension integrity.
Web Security.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的命令注入漏洞允许未授权的本地代码执行，威胁开发者环境及第三方扩展的完整性。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution over the network, exploiting a classic and highly effective web application attack vector.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution over the network, exploiting a classic and highly effective web application attack vector.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中对不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞可实现在线远程代码执行，利用了经典且高效的 Web 应用攻击向量。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized code execution in developer environments, threatening software supply chain integrity and build pipeline security.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized code execution in developer environments, threatening software supply chain integrity and build pipeline security.
Web Security.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞允许在开发者环境中执行未授权代码，威胁软件供应链完整性及构建流水线安全。

Web Security.reason: Unrestricted resource allocation in ASP.NET Core enables denial-of-service attacks, disrupting web application availability and degrading service performance under load.
Web Security.reason_en: Unrestricted resource allocation in ASP.NET Core enables denial-of-service attacks, disrupting web application availability and degrading service performance under load.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中不受限制的资源分配可导致拒绝服务（DoS）攻击，破坏 Web 应用可用性并在高负载下降低服务性能。

Web Security.reason: Insecure deserialization in SharePoint allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, risking full server compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in SharePoint allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, risking full server compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的不安全反序列化漏洞允许已认证攻击者远程执行任意代码，存在服务器全面失陷的风险。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint enables authorized users to escalate privileges and access internal network resources.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint enables authorized users to escalate privileges and access internal network resources.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞使授权用户能够提升权限并访问内部网络资源。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in SharePoint facilitates spoofing attacks against authenticated users within web environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in SharePoint facilitates spoofing attacks against authenticated users within web environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞助长了针对 Web 环境中已认证用户的欺骗攻击。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint allows authorized attackers to inject malicious scripts, leading to session hijacking and data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint allows authorized attackers to inject malicious scripts, leading to session hijacking and data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞允许授权攻击者注入恶意脚本，导致会话劫持和数据泄露。

Web Security.reason: Race condition in ASP.NET Core enables local privilege escalation within web application frameworks, compromising multi-tenant environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Race condition in ASP.NET Core enables local privilege escalation within web application frameworks, compromising multi-tenant environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的竞态条件漏洞可在Web应用框架内实现本地权限提升，危及多租户环境。

Web Security.reason: Uncontrolled resource consumption in ASP.NET Core allows remote denial-of-service attacks against hosted web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Uncontrolled resource consumption in ASP.NET Core allows remote denial-of-service attacks against hosted web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中不受控的资源消耗可导致针对托管Web应用的远程拒绝服务攻击。

Web Security.reason: Integer overflow in Microsoft JScript permits remote code execution via malicious web content or embedded scripts.
Web Security.reason_en: Integer overflow in Microsoft JScript permits remote code execution via malicious web content or embedded scripts.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft JScript中的整数溢出漏洞可通过恶意Web内容或嵌入脚本实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code exposes sensitive information over the network, risking developer environment compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code exposes sensitive information over the network, risking developer environment compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中缺失的授权机制会导致敏感信息在网络中暴露，增加开发者环境被攻陷的风险。

Web Security.reason: Critical authorization flaw in ASP.NET Core enables unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges remotely, significantly impacting web application security and API gateways running on Windows hosts.
Web Security.reason_en: Critical authorization flaw in ASP.NET Core enables unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges remotely, significantly impacting web application security and API gateways running on Windows hosts.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中存在的关键授权缺陷允许未认证攻击者远程提权，严重影响运行于Windows主机上的Web应用安全及API网关。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution. Represents a classic high-impact flaw frequently leveraged in automated web attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution. Represents a classic high-impact flaw frequently leveraged in automated web attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中对不可信数据的反序列化漏洞可触发远程代码执行。此类经典高影响缺陷常被用于自动化Web攻击。

Web Security.reason: Second deserialization vulnerability in SharePoint with identical high-risk characteristics. Indicates systemic framework weaknesses requiring comprehensive remediation.
Web Security.reason_en: Second deserialization vulnerability in SharePoint with identical high-risk characteristics. Indicates systemic framework weaknesses requiring comprehensive remediation.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中出现的第二处反序列化漏洞具有相同的高风险特征。表明存在系统性框架弱点，需进行全面修复。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint allows sophisticated spoofing attacks. Enables credential harvesting and session hijacking against authenticated web users.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint allows sophisticated spoofing attacks. Enables credential harvesting and session hijacking against authenticated web users.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞支持复杂的伪造攻击，可实现针对已认证Web用户的凭证窃取与会话劫持。

Web Security.reason: CSRF vulnerability in ASP.NET Core allows unauthorized privilege escalation. Affects modern web development frameworks deployed across thousands of enterprise applications.
Web Security.reason_en: CSRF vulnerability in ASP.NET Core allows unauthorized privilege escalation. Affects modern web development frameworks deployed across thousands of enterprise applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的CSRF漏洞可导致未授权的权限提升。该漏洞影响部署于数千个企业应用中的现代Web开发框架。

Web Security.reason: Algorithmic complexity flaw in ASP.NET Core enables remote denial of service, impacting web application availability and performance.
Web Security.reason_en: Algorithmic complexity flaw in ASP.NET Core enables remote denial of service, impacting web application availability and performance.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的算法复杂度缺陷可导致远程拒绝服务，影响Web应用的可用性与性能。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Dynamics 365 Customer Voice facilitates phishing and account spoofing, undermining trust in enterprise customer engagement tools.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Dynamics 365 Customer Voice facilitates phishing and account spoofing, undermining trust in enterprise customer engagement tools.
Web Security.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 Customer Voice中的跨站脚本漏洞助长了网络钓鱼与账号伪造行为，损害了企业对客户互动工具的信任。

Web Security.reason: XSS in the Live Share Canvas SDK allows privilege escalation in collaborative development environments, risking session hijacking and code injection.
Web Security.reason_en: XSS in the Live Share Canvas SDK allows privilege escalation in collaborative development environments, risking session hijacking and code injection.
Web Security.reason_zh: Live Share Canvas SDK中的XSS漏洞可在协作开发环境中实现权限提升，带来会话劫持与代码注入风险。

Web Security.reason: Exchange Server XSS enables phishing, session hijacking, and malicious macro delivery against mail users.
Web Security.reason_en: Exchange Server XSS enables phishing, session hijacking, and malicious macro delivery against mail users.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的XSS漏洞可对邮件用户实施网络钓鱼、会话劫持及恶意宏投递。

Web Security.reason: Exchange Server code injection allows remote command execution against critical mail infrastructure.
Web Security.reason_en: Exchange Server code injection allows remote command execution against critical mail infrastructure.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的代码注入漏洞可对关键邮件基础设施实现远程命令执行。

Web Security.reason: SharePoint authorization bypass permits unauthorized content modification and internal data leakage.
Web Security.reason_en: SharePoint authorization bypass permits unauthorized content modification and internal data leakage.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的授权绕过漏洞允许未经授权的内容修改与内部数据泄露。

Web Security.reason: Edge origin validation error facilitates cross-origin spoofing and browser-based credential theft.
Web Security.reason_en: Edge origin validation error facilitates cross-origin spoofing and browser-based credential theft.
Web Security.reason_zh: Edge中的源验证错误会助长跨域伪造及基于浏览器的凭证窃取。

Web Security.reason: Critical memory safety flaw in the Chromium-based browser enables remote code execution via crafted web pages.
Web Security.reason_en: Critical memory safety flaw in the Chromium-based browser enables remote code execution via crafted web pages.
Web Security.reason_zh: 基于Chromium的浏览器中的关键内存安全缺陷可通过构造的网页实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Arithmetic error in browser engine processing can be leveraged for sandbox escape and remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_en: Arithmetic error in browser engine processing can be leveraged for sandbox escape and remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_zh: 浏览器引擎处理过程中的算术错误可被利用以实现沙箱逃逸和远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Unsafe deserialization in browser components allows attackers to execute arbitrary code through malicious payloads.
Web Security.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in browser components allows attackers to execute arbitrary code through malicious payloads.
Web Security.reason_zh: 浏览器组件中的不安全反序列化漏洞允许攻击者通过恶意载荷执行任意代码。

Web Security.reason: Weak authentication in Microsoft Office SharePoint is actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), allowing network-based security feature bypasses that can lead to unauthorized content manipulation or data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_en: Weak authentication in Microsoft Office SharePoint is actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), allowing network-based security feature bypasses that can lead to unauthorized content manipulation or data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的弱身份验证机制已在野外遭活跃利用（列入CISA KEV），可导致基于网络的防御功能绕过，进而引发未经授权的内容篡改或数据外泄。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting flaw in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables authorized attackers to perform spoofing over a network, potentially facilitating phishing campaigns or session hijacking within enterprise web portals.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting flaw in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables authorized attackers to perform spoofing over a network, potentially facilitating phishing campaigns or session hijacking within enterprise web portals.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞使授权攻击者能够通过网络实施伪造，可能助长企业Web门户内的网络钓鱼活动或会话劫持。

Web Security.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Federation Services enables network denial of service, disrupting web-based single sign-on and identity federation.
Web Security.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Federation Services enables network denial of service, disrupting web-based single sign-on and identity federation.
Web Security.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致网络拒绝服务，破坏基于Web的单点登录与身份联合功能。

Web Security.reason: Actively exploited deserialization flaw in SharePoint enables unrestricted network code execution, demanding immediate patching due to confirmed real-world abuse.
Web Security.reason_en: Actively exploited deserialization flaw in SharePoint enables unrestricted network code execution, demanding immediate patching due to confirmed real-world abuse.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中遭活跃利用的反序列化漏洞可实现无限制的远程代码执行，鉴于已确认的现实世界滥用情况，亟需立即打补丁修复。

Web Security.reason: Remote code execution via use-after-free in Chromium-based Edge poses significant web browsing exploitation risks through malicious site rendering.
Web Security.reason_en: Remote code execution via use-after-free in Chromium-based Edge poses significant web browsing exploitation risks through malicious site rendering.
Web Security.reason_zh: 基于Chromium的Edge中的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，通过恶意站点渲染带来显著的Web浏览利用风险。

Web Security.reason: Authorization bypass in Edge allows attackers to circumvent security boundaries over the network, facilitating drive-by downloads and session hijacking.
Web Security.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Edge allows attackers to circumvent security boundaries over the network, facilitating drive-by downloads and session hijacking.
Web Security.reason_zh: Edge中的授权绕过漏洞允许攻击者通过网络突破安全边界，促成旁路下载与会话劫持。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Power BI enables network-based account spoofing and session hijacking, targeting business intelligence dashboards and corporate data.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Power BI enables network-based account spoofing and session hijacking, targeting business intelligence dashboards and corporate data.
Web Security.reason_zh: Power BI中的跨站脚本漏洞可实现基于网络的账号伪造与会话劫持，直接威胁商业智能仪表板与企业数据。

Web Security.reason: Resource exhaustion in HTTP.sys allows network-based denial-of-service, impacting Windows web server, reverse proxy, and load balancer reliability.
Web Security.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in HTTP.sys allows network-based denial-of-service, impacting Windows web server, reverse proxy, and load balancer reliability.
Web Security.reason_zh: HTTP.sys中的资源耗尽漏洞可导致基于网络的拒绝服务攻击，影响Windows Web服务器、反向代理及负载均衡器的可靠性。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated remote code execution in React server-dom packages targets modern frontend build pipelines. Exploits affect server-side rendering and static generation workflows.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in React server-dom packages targets modern frontend build pipelines. Exploits affect server-side rendering and static generation workflows.
Web Security.reason_zh: React server-dom包中存在的未认证远程代码执行漏洞瞄准现代前端构建流水线。相关漏洞利用会影响服务端渲染与静态生成工作流。

Web Security.reason: Command injection in Copilot Chat enables unauthenticated network code execution. Highlights critical risks in integrating AI assistants into web interfaces.
Web Security.reason_en: Command injection in Copilot Chat enables unauthenticated network code execution. Highlights critical risks in integrating AI assistants into web interfaces.
Web Security.reason_zh: Copilot Chat中的命令注入漏洞可实现未认证的远程代码执行。凸显了将AI助手集成至Web界面所带来的关键安全风险。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass in ASP.NET Core via assumed-immutable data allows network privilege escalation. Weakens framework-level security guarantees for web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in ASP.NET Core via assumed-immutable data allows network privilege escalation. Weakens framework-level security guarantees for web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中通过假设不可变数据实现的认证绕过可导致网络权限提升。削弱了 Web 应用的框架级安全保证。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables remote credential spoofing and session hijacking against enterprise web portals.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables remote credential spoofing and session hijacking against enterprise web portals.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可针对企业 Web 门户实现远程凭证伪造与会话劫持。

Web Security.reason: Untrusted data deserialization in SharePoint allows remote code execution, representing a high-impact attack path for web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Untrusted data deserialization in SharePoint allows remote code execution, representing a high-impact attack path for web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的不受信任数据反序列化可导致远程代码执行，为 Web 应用提供了一种高影响攻击路径。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in Exchange Server compromises email gateway security, facilitating unauthorized mail access.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in Exchange Server compromises email gateway security, facilitating unauthorized mail access.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中通过捕获重放实现的认证绕过破坏了邮件网关安全性，导致未经授权的邮件访问。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization vulnerability in SharePoint enables remote code execution via crafted web requests without authentication.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization vulnerability in SharePoint enables remote code execution via crafted web requests without authentication.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的反序列化漏洞允许在未认证的情况下通过构造的 Web 请求实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint facilitates internal network reconnaissance and lateral movement.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint facilitates internal network reconnaissance and lateral movement.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可辅助进行内网侦察与横向移动。

Web Security.reason: Actively exploited code injection in SharePoint allows remote code execution over the network, prioritized by CISA KEV.
Web Security.reason_en: Actively exploited code injection in SharePoint allows remote code execution over the network, prioritized by CISA KEV.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中被积极利用的代码注入漏洞允许通过网络实现远程代码执行，已被 CISA KEV 列为优先关注项。

Web Security.reason: Integer overflow in Outlook enables remote code execution through malicious email attachments, targeting end-users directly.
Web Security.reason_en: Integer overflow in Outlook enables remote code execution through malicious email attachments, targeting end-users directly.
Web Security.reason_zh: Outlook 中的整数溢出漏洞可通过恶意电子邮件附件实现远程代码执行，直接针对终端用户。

Web Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Server enables authenticated remote code execution, maintaining its status as a primary target for email infrastructure attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Server enables authenticated remote code execution, maintaining its status as a primary target for email infrastructure attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许经过身份验证的远程代码执行，使其继续保持成为邮件基础设施攻击的主要目标。

Web Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge allows unauthenticated remote code execution, frequently facilitating drive-by downloads and phishing campaigns.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge allows unauthenticated remote code execution, frequently facilitating drive-by downloads and phishing campaigns.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行，常被用于驱动下载和钓鱼活动。

Web Security.reason: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code permits unauthenticated remote code execution, exposing developer environments and remote workflows to compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code permits unauthenticated remote code execution, exposing developer environments and remote workflows to compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中缺失的授权检查允许未认证的远程代码执行，使开发环境和远程工作流面临被攻陷的风险。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in PowerShell Core enables unauthorized internal network reconnaissance and information disclosure via script execution.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in PowerShell Core enables unauthorized internal network reconnaissance and information disclosure via script execution.
Web Security.reason_zh: PowerShell Core 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可通过脚本执行实现未经授权的内网侦察与信息泄露。

Web Security.reason: Incorrect authorization in Adobe Experience Manager leads to arbitrary code execution under the current user context. As a widely deployed enterprise CMS, this vulnerability poses a severe risk of complete system takeover.
Web Security.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Adobe Experience Manager leads to arbitrary code execution under the current user context. As a widely deployed enterprise CMS, this vulnerability poses a severe risk of complete system takeover.
Web Security.reason_zh: Adobe Experience Manager 中的错误授权可导致在当前用户上下文中执行任意代码。作为广泛部署的企业内容管理系统（CMS），该漏洞存在极高的系统完全接管风险。

Web Security.reason: Failure to verify cryptographic signatures for JWTs in AsiaInfo BSS allows unauthenticated attackers to forge tokens and execute privileged actions. This critical bypass compromises telecom billing system integrity.
Web Security.reason_en: Failure to verify cryptographic signatures for JWTs in AsiaInfo BSS allows unauthenticated attackers to forge tokens and execute privileged actions. This critical bypass compromises telecom billing system integrity.
Web Security.reason_zh: AsiaInfo BSS 中未能验证 JWT 的加密签名，允许未认证的攻击者伪造令牌并执行特权操作。这一关键性绕过破坏了电信计费系统的完整性。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in the Azure Portal enables spoofing attacks against cloud administrators. Attackers can leverage reflected XSS to hijack sessions or redirect users to malicious endpoints.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in the Azure Portal enables spoofing attacks against cloud administrators. Attackers can leverage reflected XSS to hijack sessions or redirect users to malicious endpoints.
Web Security.reason_zh: Azure Portal 中的跨站脚本漏洞可对云管理员实施欺骗攻击。攻击者可利用反射型 XSS 劫持会话或将用户重定向至恶意端点。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based spoofing attacks, risking credential theft and malicious payload delivery in enterprise environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based spoofing attacks, risking credential theft and malicious payload delivery in enterprise environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可实现基于网络的欺骗攻击，在企业环境中可能导致凭证窃取和恶意载荷投递。

Web Security.reason: Duplicate SharePoint XSS vulnerability maintains consistent spoofing risks across web page generation, highlighting ongoing input validation gaps in collaborative platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Duplicate SharePoint XSS vulnerability maintains consistent spoofing risks across web page generation, highlighting ongoing input validation gaps in collaborative platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 重复出现的 XSS 漏洞在网页生成过程中持续带来一致的欺骗风险，凸显了协作平台输入验证机制的持续缺陷。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.1 allows remote code execution via flawed numeric type conversion in JScript, frequently leveraged in web-based exploit kits and phishing.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 allows remote code execution via flawed numeric type conversion in JScript, frequently leveraged in web-based exploit kits and phishing.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1 允许通过 JScript 中缺陷的数字类型转换实现远程代码执行，常被基于 Web 的攻击工具包和钓鱼活动利用。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.8 enables remote code execution through URL Moniker processing, directly breaching browser and application security boundaries.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 enables remote code execution through URL Moniker processing, directly breaching browser and application security boundaries.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 允许通过 URL Moniker 处理实现远程代码执行，直接突破浏览器与应用的安全边界。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.8 allows remote code execution via malicious Word documents leveraging HTML rendering flaws, commonly targeted in spear-phishing campaigns.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 allows remote code execution via malicious Word documents leveraging HTML rendering flaws, commonly targeted in spear-phishing campaigns.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 允许通过利用 HTML 渲染缺陷的恶意 Word 文档实现远程代码执行，常在鱼叉式钓鱼活动中被针对性利用。

Web Security.reason: Kong Gateway Enterprise fails to inspect large request bodies, bypassing AI content-safety filters for web traffic.
Web Security.reason_en: Kong Gateway Enterprise fails to inspect large request bodies, bypassing AI content-safety filters for web traffic.
Web Security.reason_zh: Kong Gateway Enterprise 未能检查大型请求体，导致 Web 流量的 AI 内容安全过滤机制被绕过。

Web Security.reason: HTTP request/response smuggling in VS Code allows security feature bypass, impacting developer workflows and web application testing.
Web Security.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in VS Code allows security feature bypass, impacting developer workflows and web application testing.
Web Security.reason_zh: VS Code 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞允许绕过安全功能，影响开发者工作流与 Web 应用测试。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server allows spoofing. High-severity web flaw directly affects enterprise email delivery and user trust.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server allows spoofing. High-severity web flaw directly affects enterprise email delivery and user trust.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞可导致欺骗行为。该高危 Web 漏洞直接影响企业邮件投递与用户信任。

Web Security.reason: Path traversal in Microsoft Exchange Server allows network RCE. Enables unauthorized file system access and potential remote code execution via web interfaces.
Web Security.reason_en: Path traversal in Microsoft Exchange Server allows network RCE. Enables unauthorized file system access and potential remote code execution via web interfaces.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的路径遍历漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行。该漏洞允许未经授权访问文件系统，并可能通过 Web 接口实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows privilege escalation over a network. Compromises web application logic and elevates attacker permissions.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows privilege escalation over a network. Compromises web application logic and elevates attacker permissions.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许通过网络实现权限提升。该漏洞破坏 Web 应用逻辑并提升攻击者权限。

Web Security.reason: Improper cryptographic signature verification in Skype for Business allows spoofing. Undermines communication integrity and enables man-in-the-middle attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in Skype for Business allows spoofing. Undermines communication integrity and enables man-in-the-middle attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: Skype for Business 中不当的加密签名验证机制可导致欺骗行为。该漏洞破坏了通信完整性并支持中间人攻击。

Web Security.reason: Incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Connect allows privilege escalation without user interaction, enabling attackers to access sensitive resources and administrative functionality.
Web Security.reason_en: Incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Connect allows privilege escalation without user interaction, enabling attackers to access sensitive resources and administrative functionality.
Web Security.reason_zh: Adobe Connect 中的错误授权缺陷允许无需用户交互即可实现权限提升，使攻击者能够访问敏感资源与管理功能。

Web Security.reason: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Adobe Connect can lead to privilege escalation and internal network reconnaissance without requiring user interaction.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Adobe Connect can lead to privilege escalation and internal network reconnaissance without requiring user interaction.
Web Security.reason_zh: Adobe Connect 中的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞可在无需用户交互的情况下导致权限提升与内网侦察。

Web Security.reason: Path traversal vulnerability allows attackers to read arbitrary files outside intended directories, potentially exposing sensitive configuration data and credentials.
Web Security.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability allows attackers to read arbitrary files outside intended directories, potentially exposing sensitive configuration data and credentials.
Web Security.reason_zh: 路径遍历漏洞允许攻击者读取预期目录之外的任意文件，可能导致敏感配置数据与凭证泄露。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection flaw enables low-privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code within the context of the current user, risking full backend system compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection flaw enables low-privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code within the context of the current user, risking full backend system compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: SQL 注入缺陷使低权限攻击者能够在当前用户上下文中执行任意代码，存在导致后端系统完全被攻陷的风险。

Web Security.reason: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in form fields allows attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in victims' browsers, facilitating session hijacking or credential theft.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in form fields allows attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in victims' browsers, facilitating session hijacking or credential theft.
Web Security.reason_zh: 表单字段中的存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞允许攻击者注入恶意脚本，在受害者浏览器中执行，从而导致会话劫持或凭证窃取。

Web Security.reason: Heap overflow in Microsoft JScript allows unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising web applications and browser-based script execution environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap overflow in Microsoft JScript allows unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising web applications and browser-based script execution environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft JScript 中的堆溢出漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行，危及 Web 应用及基于浏览器的脚本执行环境。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in Power Automate enables unauthorized internal network pivoting and privilege escalation within automated business workflows.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Power Automate enables unauthorized internal network pivoting and privilege escalation within automated business workflows.
Web Security.reason_zh: Power Automate 中的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞可被用于在自动化业务流程中进行未经授权的内部网络横向移动与权限提升。

Web Security.reason: Injection vulnerability in Azure Cosmos DB allows privilege escalation over the network, risking data integrity and access control in cloud NoSQL databases.
Web Security.reason_en: Injection vulnerability in Azure Cosmos DB allows privilege escalation over the network, risking data integrity and access control in cloud NoSQL databases.
Web Security.reason_zh: Azure Cosmos DB 中的注入漏洞允许通过网络进行权限提升，威胁云 NoSQL 数据库的数据完整性与访问控制。

Web Security.reason: A critical authentication bypass in a widely used WordPress plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to gain administrative control over compromised websites.
Web Security.reason_en: A critical authentication bypass in a widely used WordPress plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to gain administrative control over compromised websites.
Web Security.reason_zh: 广泛使用的 WordPress 插件中存在关键的身份验证绕过漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者获取受感染网站的管理员控制权。

Web Security.reason: Remote code execution in Rails Active Storage via ImageMagick processing enables unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files and fully compromise web servers.
Web Security.reason_en: Remote code execution in Rails Active Storage via ImageMagick processing enables unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files and fully compromise web servers.
Web Security.reason_zh: 通过 ImageMagick 处理在 Rails Active Storage 中存在的远程代码执行漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者写入任意文件并彻底入侵 Web 服务器。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in N-able N-central allows attackers to probe internal networks and exfiltrate sensitive data from managed endpoints.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in N-able N-central allows attackers to probe internal networks and exfiltrate sensitive data from managed endpoints.
Web Security.reason_zh: N-able N-central 中的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞允许攻击者探测内部网络并从受管终端泄露敏感数据。

Web Security.reason: Code injection flaws in ASP.NET Core enable unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary scripts within web application contexts.
Web Security.reason_en: Code injection flaws in ASP.NET Core enable unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary scripts within web application contexts.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的代码注入缺陷允许未认证的攻击者在 Web 应用上下文中执行任意脚本。

Web Security.reason: Path equivalence resolution vulnerabilities in WebDAV allow attackers to traverse restricted directories and elevate privileges over HTTP.
Web Security.reason_en: Path equivalence resolution vulnerabilities in WebDAV allow attackers to traverse restricted directories and elevate privileges over HTTP.
Web Security.reason_zh: WebDAV 中的路径等价解析漏洞允许攻击者遍历受限目录并通过 HTTP 提升权限。

Web Security.reason: Observable discrepancies in Active Directory Federation Services leak sensitive identity metadata, aiding targeted social engineering or reconnaissance.
Web Security.reason_en: Observable discrepancies in Active Directory Federation Services leak sensitive identity metadata, aiding targeted social engineering or reconnaissance.
Web Security.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中可观察到的差异会泄露敏感的身份元数据，助长定向的社会工程学攻击或侦察活动。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in ASP.NET Core allows remote code execution, remaining a prevalent threat for web application security and session hijacking.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in ASP.NET Core allows remote code execution, remaining a prevalent threat for web application security and session hijacking.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可导致远程代码执行，仍是 Web 应用安全与会话劫持的主要威胁。

Web Security.reason: Integer overflow in Microsoft SharePoint enables remote code execution, requiring urgent patching due to its widespread use in enterprise collaboration.
Web Security.reason_en: Integer overflow in Microsoft SharePoint enables remote code execution, requiring urgent patching due to its widespread use in enterprise collaboration.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint 中的整数溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，鉴于其在企业协作中的广泛应用，需紧急打补丁修复。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows privilege escalation, enabling attackers to pivot to internal network resources.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows privilege escalation, enabling attackers to pivot to internal network resources.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞可导致权限提升，使攻击者能够横向移动到内部网络资源。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9.4 HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core enables request tampering and cache poisoning attacks against modern web applications and APIs.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.4 HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core enables request tampering and cache poisoning attacks against modern web applications and APIs.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中 CVSS 评分为 9.4 的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞可对现代 Web 应用和 API 实施请求篡改与缓存投毒攻击。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9.3 cross-site scripting in Exchange Server facilitates account spoofing and phishing campaigns, directly impacting enterprise communication security.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.3 cross-site scripting in Exchange Server facilitates account spoofing and phishing campaigns, directly impacting enterprise communication security.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中 CVSS 评分为 9.3 的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可促成账户伪造与钓鱼活动，直接影响企业通信安全。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.8 incorrect authorization in Exchange Server allows privilege escalation, potentially granting attackers administrative control over mail systems and user data.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 incorrect authorization in Exchange Server allows privilege escalation, potentially granting attackers administrative control over mail systems and user data.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的错误授权漏洞可导致权限提升，可能赋予攻击者对邮件系统和用户数据的管理员控制权。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in SharePoint enables unauthenticated network spoofing and credential theft through malicious web content generation.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in SharePoint enables unauthenticated network spoofing and credential theft through malicious web content generation.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可通过生成恶意 Web 内容实现未认证的网络欺骗与凭证窃取。

Web Security.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in IIS directly impacts web server availability and enables remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in IIS directly impacts web server availability and enables remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_zh: IIS 中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞直接影响 Web 服务器的可用性，并可导致远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Improper path equivalence resolution in WebDAV enables unauthorized code execution via crafted HTTP requests.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper path equivalence resolution in WebDAV enables unauthorized code execution via crafted HTTP requests.
Web Security.reason_zh: WebDAV 中不当的路径等价解析漏洞可通过构造的 HTTP 请求实现未授权的代码执行。

Web Security.reason: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core bypasses security controls and allows request manipulation.
Web Security.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core bypasses security controls and allows request manipulation.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞可绕过安全控制机制并允许请求篡改。

Web Security.reason: Missing authorization in SharePoint allows privilege escalation within web content management systems.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in SharePoint allows privilege escalation within web content management systems.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中缺失的授权检查可在 Web 内容管理系统中导致权限提升。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint facilitates client-side spoofing and session hijacking attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint facilitates client-side spoofing and session hijacking attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可促成客户端伪造与会话劫持攻击。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass in ASP.NET Core undermines security mechanisms in deployed web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in ASP.NET Core undermines security mechanisms in deployed web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的身份验证绕过漏洞会破坏已部署 Web 应用的安全机制。

Web Security.reason: Unthrottled resource allocation in ASP.NET Core leads to denial of service through resource exhaustion.
Web Security.reason_en: Unthrottled resource allocation in ASP.NET Core leads to denial of service through resource exhaustion.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中缺乏限制的资源分配会导致资源耗尽型拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。

Web Security.reason: Memory corruption in SAP Web Dispatcher (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated remote code execution, directly impacting web application proxy deployments.
Web Security.reason_en: Memory corruption in SAP Web Dispatcher (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated remote code execution, directly impacting web application proxy deployments.
Web Security.reason_zh: SAP Web Dispatcher（CVSS 10.0）中的内存损坏漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行，直接影响 Web 应用代理部署。

Web Security.reason: Heap buffer overflow in WebDAV (CVSS 8.8) enables remote privilege escalation over the network, affecting file synchronization and web publishing services.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in WebDAV (CVSS 8.8) enables remote privilege escalation over the network, affecting file synchronization and web publishing services.
Web Security.reason_zh: WebDAV（CVSS 8.8）中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程权限提升，影响文件同步与 Web 发布服务。

Web Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution through malicious web content, affecting a major consumer and enterprise browser engine.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution through malicious web content, affecting a major consumer and enterprise browser engine.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意 Web 内容实现远程代码执行，影响主流消费级与企业级浏览器引擎。

Web Security.reason: Type confusion in Edge's rendering pipeline facilitates remote code execution, highlighting persistent memory safety risks in Chromium-based architectures.
Web Security.reason_en: Type confusion in Edge's rendering pipeline facilitates remote code execution, highlighting persistent memory safety risks in Chromium-based architectures.
Web Security.reason_zh: Edge 渲染管线中的类型混淆漏洞可导致远程代码执行，凸显了基于 Chromium 架构中持续存在的内存安全风险。

Web Security.reason: Resource exhaustion vulnerability in ASP.NET Core allows unauthenticated denial-of-service attacks against modern web applications and API endpoints.
Web Security.reason_en: Resource exhaustion vulnerability in ASP.NET Core allows unauthenticated denial-of-service attacks against modern web applications and API endpoints.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的资源耗尽漏洞允许对现代 Web 应用和 API 端点发起未认证的拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。

Web Security.reason: Acceptance of empty passwords in OpenObserve’s authentication validator allows unauthenticated access to a cloud-native observability platform, risking full system compromise and data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_en: Acceptance of empty passwords in OpenObserve’s authentication validator allows unauthenticated access to a cloud-native observability platform, risking full system compromise and data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_zh: OpenObserve 的身份验证校验器接受空密码，允许未认证访问云原生可观测性平台，可能导致系统完全沦陷与数据外泄。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated access to Chartbrew’s BullMQ admin dashboard exposes internal job queues and application state, facilitating operational disruption or sensitive data leakage.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated access to Chartbrew’s BullMQ admin dashboard exposes internal job queues and application state, facilitating operational disruption or sensitive data leakage.
Web Security.reason_zh: 未认证访问 Chartbrew 的 BullMQ 管理面板会暴露内部作业队列与应用状态，从而导致业务中断或敏感数据泄露。

Web Security.reason: Apache Juneau microservice framework lacks pathname restrictions, enabling attackers to traverse directories and manipulate arbitrary files on the server.
Web Security.reason_en: Apache Juneau microservice framework lacks pathname restrictions, enabling attackers to traverse directories and manipulate arbitrary files on the server.
Web Security.reason_zh: Apache Juneau 微服务框架缺乏路径限制，使攻击者能够进行目录遍历并操纵服务器上的任意文件。

Web Security.reason: 2FAuth incorrectly trusts reverse proxy authentication headers, allowing unauthenticated users to bypass multi-factor login requirements and gain account access.
Web Security.reason_en: 2FAuth incorrectly trusts reverse proxy authentication headers, allowing unauthenticated users to bypass multi-factor login requirements and gain account access.
Web Security.reason_zh: 2FAuth 错误信任反向代理认证头，导致未认证用户可绕过多因素认证登录要求并获取账户访问权限。

Web Security.reason: WP w3all phpBB integration plugin suffers from SQL injection, exposing backend application data to remote exploitation and data theft.
Web Security.reason_en: WP w3all phpBB integration plugin suffers from SQL injection, exposing backend application data to remote exploitation and data theft.
Web Security.reason_zh: WP w3all phpBB 集成插件存在 SQL 注入漏洞，致使后端应用数据易受远程利用与数据窃取。

Web Security.reason: SuperTokens SAML callback handler fails to validate RelayState and InResponseTo fields, facilitating authentication token replay and session hijacking attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: SuperTokens SAML callback handler fails to validate RelayState and InResponseTo fields, facilitating authentication token replay and session hijacking attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: SuperTokens SAML 回调处理器未能验证 RelayState 和 InResponseTo 字段，从而导致身份验证令牌重放与会话劫持攻击。

Web Security.reason: Apache Juneau fails to HTML-encode variable substitutions in page chrome elements, enabling cross-site scripting attacks. Applications relying on this REST framework are vulnerable to session hijacking and credential theft.
Web Security.reason_en: Apache Juneau fails to HTML-encode variable substitutions in page chrome elements, enabling cross-site scripting attacks. Applications relying on this REST framework are vulnerable to session hijacking and credential theft.
Web Security.reason_zh: Apache Juneau 未对页面 chrome 元素中的变量替换执行 HTML 编码，导致跨站脚本攻击。依赖该 REST 框架的应用易遭受会话劫持与凭据窃取。

Web Security.reason: JetBrains Datalore allows unauthenticated code execution through published interactive reports, breaking tenant isolation in cloud-based notebook environments. Attackers can run arbitrary scripts without valid credentials.
Web Security.reason_en: JetBrains Datalore allows unauthenticated code execution through published interactive reports, breaking tenant isolation in cloud-based notebook environments. Attackers can run arbitrary scripts without valid credentials.
Web Security.reason_zh: JetBrains Datalore 允许通过已发布的交互式报告执行未认证代码，破坏了云笔记本环境中的多租户隔离机制。攻击者无需有效凭据即可运行任意脚本。

Web Security.reason: OpenEMR's RingCentral fax module contains a path traversal vulnerability in the disposeDocument method, permitting authenticated attackers to read and write arbitrary system files. This can lead to credential theft and full application compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: OpenEMR's RingCentral fax module contains a path traversal vulnerability in the disposeDocument method, permitting authenticated attackers to read and write arbitrary system files. This can lead to credential theft and full application compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: OpenEMR 的 RingCentral 传真模块在 disposeDocument 方法中存在路径遍历漏洞，允许已认证攻击者读写任意系统文件，进而可能导致凭据窃取及应用程序被完全控制。

Web Security.reason: Grafana OSS and Enterprise versions allow any user role, including viewers, to create, publish, and delete dashboard snapshots due to missing authorization controls. This exposes sensitive operational metrics and analytics to unauthorized parties.
Web Security.reason_en: Grafana OSS and Enterprise versions allow any user role, including viewers, to create, publish, and delete dashboard snapshots due to missing authorization controls. This exposes sensitive operational metrics and analytics to unauthorized parties.
Web Security.reason_zh: Grafana OSS 与企业版因缺失授权控制，允许任何用户角色（含查看者）创建、发布和删除仪表板快照，导致敏感操作指标与分析数据向未授权方泄露。

Web Security.reason: Default credentials in INDOTALENT WHMS allow unauthenticated attackers to gain full administrator access without any initial exploitation step.
Web Security.reason_en: Default credentials in INDOTALENT WHMS allow unauthenticated attackers to gain full administrator access without any initial exploitation step.
Web Security.reason_zh: INDOTALENT WHMS 存在默认凭据问题，未认证攻击者无需任何初始利用即可获取完整的管理员访问权限。

Web Security.reason: Server-side template injection in mailcow enables domain administrators to execute arbitrary commands within shared containers via malicious email footers.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side template injection in mailcow enables domain administrators to execute arbitrary commands within shared containers via malicious email footers.
Web Security.reason_zh: mailcow 存在服务端模板注入漏洞，域管理员可通过恶意邮件页脚在共享容器内执行任意命令。

Web Security.reason: IDOR in the MatchPoint API bypasses authorization checks via manipulated headers, exposing sensitive financial, banking, and personal user data.
Web Security.reason_en: IDOR in the MatchPoint API bypasses authorization checks via manipulated headers, exposing sensitive financial, banking, and personal user data.
Web Security.reason_zh: MatchPoint API 存在不直接对象引用（IDOR）漏洞，攻击者可通过篡改请求标头绕过授权检查，导致敏感财务、金融及个人用户数据泄露。

Web Security.reason: A hardcoded static credential in the MatchPoint platform grants unauthenticated attackers direct access to core API services.
Web Security.reason_en: A hardcoded static credential in the MatchPoint platform grants unauthenticated attackers direct access to core API services.
Web Security.reason_zh: MatchPoint 平台存在硬编码静态凭据，未认证攻击者可直接访问其核心 API 服务。

Web Security.reason: Incorrect authorization in PowerSYSTEM Center allows low-privileged users to access administrative resources, breaking role-based access controls.
Web Security.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in PowerSYSTEM Center allows low-privileged users to access administrative resources, breaking role-based access controls.
Web Security.reason_zh: PowerSYSTEM Center 存在授权逻辑缺陷，允许低权限用户访问管理资源，破坏了基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）机制。

Web Security.reason: Insufficient input validation in PowerSYSTEM Center's report designer enables authenticated users to execute unauthorized SQL commands against the backend.
Web Security.reason_en: Insufficient input validation in PowerSYSTEM Center's report designer enables authenticated users to execute unauthorized SQL commands against the backend.
Web Security.reason_zh: PowerSYSTEM Center 报告设计器存在输入验证不足的问题，已认证用户可利用该漏洞对后端执行未授权的 SQL 命令。

Web Security.reason: Stored XSS in Joomla iCagenda allows attackers to inject malicious JavaScript via event URLs, compromising victim sessions and browser contexts.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored XSS in Joomla iCagenda allows attackers to inject malicious JavaScript via event URLs, compromising victim sessions and browser contexts.
Web Security.reason_zh: Joomla iCagenda 存在存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，攻击者可通过事件 URL 注入恶意 JavaScript，从而劫持受害者会话及浏览器上下文。

Web Security.reason: Improper URL validation in JetBrains YouTrack allows apps to send unauthorized REST requests without user confirmation, bypassing security prompts.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper URL validation in JetBrains YouTrack allows apps to send unauthorized REST requests without user confirmation, bypassing security prompts.
Web Security.reason_zh: JetBrains YouTrack 存在 URL 验证缺陷，允许应用在未经用户确认的情况下发送未授权的 REST 请求，从而绕过安全提示。

Web Security.reason: Stored XSS in Foxit Workspace's file share preview executes embedded scripts when victims open shared documents, leading to account takeover.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored XSS in Foxit Workspace's file share preview executes embedded scripts when victims open shared documents, leading to account takeover.
Web Security.reason_zh: Foxit Workspace 文件共享预览功能存在存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，受害者打开共享文档时将触发嵌入式脚本执行，进而导致账户接管。

Web Security.reason: Inefficient YAML parsing in Symfony enables denial-of-service attacks by forcing PHP processes to hang indefinitely on crafted documents.
Web Security.reason_en: Inefficient YAML parsing in Symfony enables denial-of-service attacks by forcing PHP processes to hang indefinitely on crafted documents.
Web Security.reason_zh: Symfony 的 YAML 解析效率低下，攻击者可利用精心构造的文档使 PHP 进程无限挂起，从而引发拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。

Web Security.reason: Case-sensitive regex bypass in Symfony Serializer allows uppercase DATA schemes to evade validation, resulting in arbitrary local file reads.
Web Security.reason_en: Case-sensitive regex bypass in Symfony Serializer allows uppercase DATA schemes to evade validation, resulting in arbitrary local file reads.
Web Security.reason_zh: Symfony Serializer 存在大小写敏感的正则表达式绕过漏洞，攻击者可利用大写 DATA 协议方案绕过验证，实现任意本地文件读取。

Web Security.reason: HPACK header exhaustion in ninenines cowlib allows unauthenticated peers to crash HTTP/2 endpoints by depleting connection memory.
Web Security.reason_en: HPACK header exhaustion in ninenines cowlib allows unauthenticated peers to crash HTTP/2 endpoints by depleting connection memory.
Web Security.reason_zh: ninenines cowlib 存在 HPACK 头部耗尽漏洞，未认证的对等节点可通过耗尽连接内存导致 HTTP/2 端点崩溃。

Web Security.reason: Connection process memory exhaustion in ninenines cowboy impacts HTTP/1.1 stability by failing to throttle long-running request handlers.
Web Security.reason_en: Connection process memory exhaustion in ninenines cowboy impacts HTTP/1.1 stability by failing to throttle long-running request handlers.
Web Security.reason_zh: ninenines cowboy 存在连接进程内存耗尽问题，由于未能对长时间运行的请求处理程序进行限流，影响了 HTTP/1.1 的稳定性。

Web Security.reason: SSRF in Foxit Workspace's undocumented API endpoint forces the server to request arbitrary internal or external URLs, leaking sensitive data.
Web Security.reason_en: SSRF in Foxit Workspace's undocumented API endpoint forces the server to request arbitrary internal or external URLs, leaking sensitive data.
Web Security.reason_zh: Foxit Workspace 未公开的 API 端点存在服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，可导致服务器请求任意内网或外网 URL，进而泄露敏感数据。

Web Security.reason: File-upload SSRF in Foxit Workspace allows attackers to induce server requests to internal resources and return their contents to the client.
Web Security.reason_en: File-upload SSRF in Foxit Workspace allows attackers to induce server requests to internal resources and return their contents to the client.
Web Security.reason_zh: Foxit Workspace 存在基于文件上传的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，攻击者可诱导服务器请求内部资源并将响应内容返回给客户端。

Web Security.reason: XXE in Wowza Streaming Engine processes untrusted XML entities, allowing remote attackers to read local files with process privileges.
Web Security.reason_en: XXE in Wowza Streaming Engine processes untrusted XML entities, allowing remote attackers to read local files with process privileges.
Web Security.reason_zh: Wowza Streaming Engine 存在 XML 外部实体（XXE）注入漏洞，处理不受信任的 XML 实体时，允许远程攻击者以进程权限读取本地文件。

Web Security.reason: Directory traversal in WordPress Ultra Addons enables unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary server files via manipulated mail components.
Web Security.reason_en: Directory traversal in WordPress Ultra Addons enables unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary server files via manipulated mail components.
Web Security.reason_zh: WordPress Ultra Addons 存在目录遍历漏洞，未认证攻击者可通过篡改邮件组件读取服务器上的任意文件。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in Nango's orchestrator API permits unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary database queries via crafted task group keys.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in Nango's orchestrator API permits unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary database queries via crafted task group keys.
Web Security.reason_zh: Nango 的编排器 API 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，未认证攻击者可通过精心构造的任务组密钥执行任意数据库查询。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass in Aptabase allows forging of sign-in links using publicly known secrets, enabling unauthorized account access.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Aptabase allows forging of sign-in links using publicly known secrets, enabling unauthorized account access.
Web Security.reason_zh: Aptabase 存在身份验证绕过漏洞，攻击者可利用公开已知的密钥伪造登录链接，从而获取未授权的账户访问权限。

Web Security.reason: IDOR in Dolibarr expense report payments allows authenticated users to view other users' financial data without proper ownership validation.
Web Security.reason_en: IDOR in Dolibarr expense report payments allows authenticated users to view other users' financial data without proper ownership validation.
Web Security.reason_zh: Dolibarr 费用报销支付模块存在不直接对象引用（IDOR）漏洞，已认证用户可在缺乏所有权验证的情况下查看其他用户的财务数据。

Web Security.reason: Improper authorization in Firekylin exposes administrator-only secrets like TOTP and cloud storage keys to editor-role users.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper authorization in Firekylin exposes administrator-only secrets like TOTP and cloud storage keys to editor-role users.
Web Security.reason_zh: Firekylin 存在授权缺陷，导致仅限管理员访问的敏感信息（如 TOTP 密钥和云存储密钥）向编辑者角色用户泄露。

Web Security.reason: Uninitialized variable in ModSecurity's XML processing can lead to crashes or unpredictable behavior when parsing malicious request bodies.
Web Security.reason_en: Uninitialized variable in ModSecurity's XML processing can lead to crashes or unpredictable behavior when parsing malicious request bodies.
Web Security.reason_zh: ModSecurity 的 XML 处理中存在未初始化变量，解析恶意请求体时可能导致崩溃或不可预测的行为。

Web Security.reason: Missing authentication in SourceCodester Smart Attendance System bypasses admin creation checks, allowing unauthorized account provisioning.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authentication in SourceCodester Smart Attendance System bypasses admin creation checks, allowing unauthorized account provisioning.
Web Security.reason_zh: SourceCodester Smart Attendance System 中缺少身份验证，可绕过管理员创建检查，允许未经授权的用户配置账户。

Web Security.reason: API key cache poisoning in pyLoad enables unauthorized access by exploiting cached legitimate keys with forged identifiers.
Web Security.reason_en: API key cache poisoning in pyLoad enables unauthorized access by exploiting cached legitimate keys with forged identifiers.
Web Security.reason_zh: pyLoad 中的 API 密钥缓存投毒漏洞可通过利用带有伪造标识符的已缓存合法密钥实现未授权访问。

Web Security.reason: Privilege escalation in frab conference management allows crew users to grant themselves organization roles via unchecked nested attributes.
Web Security.reason_en: Privilege escalation in frab conference management allows crew users to grant themselves organization roles via unchecked nested attributes.
Web Security.reason_zh: frab 会议管理系统中的权限提升漏洞允许工作人员用户通过未检查的嵌套属性为自己授予组织角色。

Web Security.reason: Role escalation in Storyden permits users with MANAGE_ROLES to create administrator accounts without proper authorization checks.
Web Security.reason_en: Role escalation in Storyden permits users with MANAGE_ROLES to create administrator accounts without proper authorization checks.
Web Security.reason_zh: Storyden 中的角色提升漏洞允许拥有 MANAGE_ROLES 权限的用户在缺乏适当授权检查的情况下创建管理员账户。

Web Security.reason: Unrestricted URL fetching in LiveDocs enables SSRF and open redirect attacks by passing client-supplied URLs directly to network clients.
Web Security.reason_en: Unrestricted URL fetching in LiveDocs enables SSRF and open redirect attacks by passing client-supplied URLs directly to network clients.
Web Security.reason_zh: LiveDocs 中不受限制的 URL 获取功能通过将客户端提供的 URL 直接传递给网络客户端，导致 SSRF 和开放重定向攻击。

Web Security.reason: Reflected cross-site scripting in UpSolution Core allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web interfaces, compromising user sessions and sensitive data.
Web Security.reason_en: Reflected cross-site scripting in UpSolution Core allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web interfaces, compromising user sessions and sensitive data.
Web Security.reason_zh: UpSolution Core 中的反射型跨站脚本漏洞允许攻击者将恶意脚本注入 Web 界面，从而破坏用户会话和敏感数据。

Web Security.reason: Default-disabled TLS certificate validation in the V programming language standard library enables on-path attackers to intercept and modify encrypted web traffic.
Web Security.reason_en: Default-disabled TLS certificate validation in the V programming language standard library enables on-path attackers to intercept and modify encrypted web traffic.
Web Security.reason_zh: V 编程语言标准库中默认禁用的 TLS 证书验证机制使中间人攻击者能够拦截并修改加密的 Web 流量。

Web Security.reason: Python's incremental HTML parser is vulnerable to CPU denial-of-service via crafted unterminated markup. Widely affects web scrapers and backend services processing untrusted HTML content.
Web Security.reason_en: Python's incremental HTML parser is vulnerable to CPU denial-of-service via crafted unterminated markup. Widely affects web scrapers and backend services processing untrusted HTML content.
Web Security.reason_zh: Python 的增量 HTML 解析器易受通过构造的不闭合标记引发的 CPU 拒绝服务攻击影响。广泛影响处理不受信任 HTML 内容的网页抓取工具和后端服务。

Web Security.reason: libexpat parser allows triggering massive dynamic memory allocations from small documents, leading to resource exhaustion in web APIs. Essential to mitigate for services relying on XML/HTML parsing.
Web Security.reason_en: libexpat parser allows triggering massive dynamic memory allocations from small documents, leading to resource exhaustion in web APIs. Essential to mitigate for services relying on XML/HTML parsing.
Web Security.reason_zh: libexpat 解析器允许从小型文档触发大规模动态内存分配，导致 Web API 资源耗尽。依赖 XML/HTML 解析的服务必须优先修复此问题。

Web Security.reason: Python SSLContext silently skips hostname verification when server_hostname is omitted despite check_hostname being enabled. Undermines TLS security guarantees for web clients and servers using this configuration.
Web Security.reason_en: Python SSLContext silently skips hostname verification when server_hostname is omitted despite check_hostname being enabled. Undermines TLS security guarantees for web clients and servers using this configuration.
Web Security.reason_zh: 尽管已启用 check_hostname，Python SSLContext 在省略 server_hostname 时仍会静默跳过主机名验证。破坏了使用该配置的 Web 客户端和服务器的 TLS 安全保证。

Web Security.reason: Blind SQL injection in the Bookly WordPress plugin compromises database integrity and exposes sensitive appointment data.
Web Security.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in the Bookly WordPress plugin compromises database integrity and exposes sensitive appointment data.
Web Security.reason_zh: Bookly WordPress 插件中的盲注 SQL 注入漏洞破坏了数据库完整性，并泄露了敏感的预约数据。

Web Security.reason: Race condition in WPML's SSO handler generates predictable tokens, allowing authentication bypass across multilingual sites.
Web Security.reason_en: Race condition in WPML's SSO handler generates predictable tokens, allowing authentication bypass across multilingual sites.
Web Security.reason_zh: WPML 的单点登录（SSO）处理器中存在竞态条件，会生成可预测的令牌，从而允许在多语言站点间绕过身份验证。

Web Security.reason: Path traversal in Plesk's Site Import extension redirects privileged sessions, enabling arbitrary code execution as root.
Web Security.reason_en: Path traversal in Plesk's Site Import extension redirects privileged sessions, enabling arbitrary code execution as root.
Web Security.reason_zh: Plesk 的网站导入扩展中存在路径遍历漏洞，可重定向特权会话，从而实现以 root 权限执行任意代码。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Critical heap overflow in SQL Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, directly threatening database availability and confidentiality.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Critical heap overflow in SQL Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, directly threatening database availability and confidentiality.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的严重堆溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，直接威胁数据库的可用性和机密性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: SQL injection vulnerability enables authenticated attackers to elevate privileges and manipulate database configurations, risking full data compromise.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: SQL injection vulnerability enables authenticated attackers to elevate privileges and manipulate database configurations, risking full data compromise.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL 注入漏洞使已认证的攻击者能够提升权限并操纵数据库配置，存在数据完全泄露的风险。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap overflow permits unauthorized network-based code execution within database services, expanding the attack surface for backend systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap overflow permits unauthorized network-based code execution within database services, expanding the attack surface for backend systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 堆溢出漏洞允许在数据库服务中进行未经授权的基于网络的代码执行，扩大了后端系统的攻击面。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Improper input validation in Microsoft Exchange Server enables remote code execution, directly jeopardizing enterprise communication infrastructure and data confidentiality.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Improper input validation in Microsoft Exchange Server enables remote code execution, directly jeopardizing enterprise communication infrastructure and data confidentiality.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的输入验证不当漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接危及企业通信基础设施和数据机密性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Code injection in Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands, facilitating complete mail server takeover and configuration manipulation.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Code injection in Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands, facilitating complete mail server takeover and configuration manipulation.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的代码注入漏洞允许已认证的攻击者执行任意命令，从而导致邮件服务器被完全接管及配置被篡改。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Exposed dangerous methods in SQL Server permit authorized users to escalate privileges, increasing the likelihood of database compromise and sensitive data exfiltration.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Exposed dangerous methods in SQL Server permit authorized users to escalate privileges, increasing the likelihood of database compromise and sensitive data exfiltration.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中暴露的危险方法允许授权用户提升权限，增加了数据库被攻破和敏感数据外泄的可能性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Improper cryptographic signature verification in the SQL Server JDBC Driver allows security feature bypass, jeopardizing database connection integrity.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in the SQL Server JDBC Driver allows security feature bypass, jeopardizing database connection integrity.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server JDBC 驱动程序中的密码学签名验证不当漏洞允许绕过安全特性，危及数据库连接完整性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution, directly threatening database engine stability and data confidentiality.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution, directly threatening database engine stability and data confidentiality.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接威胁数据库引擎稳定性和数据机密性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL permits remote code execution via database connectivity layers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL permits remote code execution via database connectivity layers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL 的 WDAC OLE DB 提供程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过数据库连接层进行远程代码执行。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Use-after-free in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL allows remote code execution, compromising middleware data access mechanisms.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Use-after-free in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL allows remote code execution, compromising middleware data access mechanisms.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL 的 WDAC OLE DB 提供程序中的释放后使用（Use-after-free）漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏中间件数据访问机制。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution over the network, directly endangering critical database assets, transaction integrity, and sensitive organizational data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution over the network, directly endangering critical database assets, transaction integrity, and sensitive organizational data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，直接危及关键数据库资产、事务完整性及敏感的组织数据。

Databases & Middleware.reason: A heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, risking full database compromise.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, risking full database compromise.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证的攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，存在数据库完全被攻破的风险。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Untrusted pointer dereference in SQL Server allows network-based privilege escalation, potentially granting administrative access to sensitive data stores.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in SQL Server allows network-based privilege escalation, potentially granting administrative access to sensitive data stores.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的非信任指针解引用漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，可能向攻击者授予对敏感数据存储的管理员访问权限。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution. Directly compromises database integrity and confidentiality on internet-facing instances.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution. Directly compromises database integrity and confidentiality on internet-facing instances.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。直接危及面向互联网的实例的数据库完整性与机密性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in SQL Server allows information disclosure. Undermines database security controls and exposes sensitive query data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in SQL Server allows information disclosure. Undermines database security controls and exposes sensitive query data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的捕获重放攻击可实现身份验证绕过，导致信息泄露。破坏了数据库安全控制措施并暴露了敏感的查询数据。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap overflow in WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL enables remote code execution. Compromises database connectivity layers and Windows Defender Application Control policies.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap overflow in WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL enables remote code execution. Compromises database connectivity layers and Windows Defender Application Control policies.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL 的 WDAC OLE DB 提供程序中的堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。破坏了数据库连接层及 Windows Defender Application Control 策略。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution over the network, directly threatening core enterprise data stores.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution over the network, directly threatening core enterprise data stores.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，直接威胁核心企业数据存储。

Databases & Middleware.reason: ODBC Driver heap overflow allows remote code execution, exploiting a widely used database connectivity interface to compromise backend systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: ODBC Driver heap overflow allows remote code execution, exploiting a widely used database connectivity interface to compromise backend systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: ODBC Driver 堆溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，利用广泛使用的数据库连接接口破坏后端系统。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Use-after-free in RPC Runtime enables local privilege escalation, weakening inter-process communication security and facilitating malware persistence.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Use-after-free in RPC Runtime enables local privilege escalation, weakening inter-process communication security and facilitating malware persistence.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: RPC Runtime 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，削弱进程间通信安全性并助长恶意软件持久化。

Databases & Middleware.reason: .NET authorization flaw allows local privilege escalation in hosted enterprise applications and services.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: .NET authorization flaw allows local privilege escalation in hosted enterprise applications and services.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: .NET 授权缺陷允许托管的企业应用程序和服务发生本地权限提升。

Databases & Middleware.reason: ASP.NET Core uncontrolled resource consumption causes targeted denial of service against web backends.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: ASP.NET Core uncontrolled resource consumption causes targeted denial of service against web backends.
